parameters.name: AccessType
parameters.description:
The access type of the site. Valid values:

- **NS**: access by using managed NS.
- **CNAME**: access by configuring a CNAME record.

parameters.name: Coverage
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Valid values:
- **domestic**: the Chinese mainland only.
- **global**: global.
- **overseas**: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the [ListUserRatePlanInstances](~~2852398~~) operation to obtain the instance ID. You must specify at least one of the instance ID and site ID. If both are specified, the instance ID takes precedence.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the default resource group ID.
